summary: Energy Transition Special Opportunities filed an 8-K reporting the consummation of its initial public offering (IPO) and a simultaneous private placement on May 18, 2026. The SPAC issued 15,000,000 units at $10.00 per unit, each consisting of one Class A ordinary share and one-half warrant, for gross proceeds of $150 million. Concurrently, the sponsor and underwriter representative purchased 5,375,000 private placement warrants at $1.00 each, generating $5.375 million. Net proceeds of $150.75 million, including $6 million deferred underwriting commissions, were placed in trust. This is a standard SPAC IPO; watch for future business combination announcement and shareholder vote.
